name: story-loader
title_zh: 打开故事项目先装好记忆与索引的存档读取器
tagline_zh: 续写长篇时不翻聊天记录、不丢伏笔。启动即把项目索引与记忆读入上下文，新开旧续都从同一张地图出发。
tagline_en: Resume long-form fiction without scrolling chat logs or losing threads. Loads project index and memory into.
desc_en: Load a story project's index and memory into context. Also use to start new projects.
why_zh: 把「项目状态」当一等公民，而非靠提示词拼凑。记忆与索引结构化装载，上下文边界清晰。
why_en: Treats project state as a first-class citizen, not a prompt hack. Structurally loads memory and index so character motives and.
limit_zh: 只认 hermes-story-architect 约定的项目目录结构；不读散装 txt 或非本工具生成的笔记。
limit_en: Only reads projects following hermes-story-architect's directory spec; no loose txt or foreign notes. Memory loads as a snapshot—won't track live.
title_en: Load a story project's index and memory into context
